channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Big Names Flock to Ruby-Red Florida to Sway Voters in Unexpectedly Close Contests
item.description: President Trump will rally on Friday in a Republican state where Democrats have their eye on several House races.

item.title: NPR: Will a macaque eat a grape sitting on a pile of poo? A study on germaphobia
item.description: When an outbreak strikes, humans try to avoid germs. (Remember wiping off groceries at the start of the pandemic?) What about ... monkeys?

item.title: BBC News: Meghan says she was informed about 'disturbing allegations' against her father in 2018
item.description: The Duchess of Sussex issues a statement following reports her father Thomas Markle is being investigated over child sex abuse images in the Philippines.

item.title: The Guardian: Reader Q&A: what’s next for France? Ask our Europe columnists – live
item.description: Guardian Europe columnists Rokhaya Diallo and Alexander Hurst are taking questions from readers about the riots and protests in France. Join the discussion in the comments here . Michael1611 asks: As Jon Henley suggests…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Conte dismisses reports of Man United takeover with Carrick’s job uncertain
item.description: Ex-Chelsea boss Antonio Conte denies Manchester United link, says reports he demanded full control of club 'unfounded'.

item.title: Ars Technica: The reactor meant to showcase nuclear’s comeback keeps hitting problems
item.description: A contractor fell into a reactor cavity and a bundle of fuel rods almost fell over.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: She Was the DEA’s Premier Crypto Detective. The Clues Led Straight to Her Own Family
item.description: To escape the chaos of her Russian childhood, Lili Infante became an American law enforcement prodigy. She pioneered the DEA’s investigations of the dark web—never suspecting who she’d find hiding there.

item.title: WIRED Science: The ‘Exotic Physics’ Behind a Mysterious 1,000-Mile Cloud on Mars
item.description: The cloud has baffled astronomers since its discovery in 2018. Now, a new study offers a possible cause for its appearance.

item.title: WIRED Business: Palmer Luckey and Ben Lamm Made a Genetically Modified Military Dog Startup
item.description: Warhound came out of stealth on Wednesday with $200 million in funding and a mission to create “elite working dogs” equipped with "advanced body armor."

item.title: The New Yorker: Inside Meta’s Efforts to Prevent School Shootings
item.description: Algorithmic social media, which has helped create the conditions for the spread of such violence, is reckoning with how it can be part of the solution.
